codex_cases.prompt: Choose a package boundary for a three-module change. Inspect callers, dependencies, build targets, generated ownership, and tests; compare two candidates and a do-less baseline; use only an existing repository decision format if one is already authoritative.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates software-architecture, maps ownership and contracts, compares materially different candidates plus do-less, and reports migration, rollback, rejected alternatives, and repository-native checks without creating a custom schema or generated report.

codex_cases.prompt: Audit and repair a dependency cycle across three sibling modules while preserving the public API and existing generator ownership.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Uses repository evidence to identify the owning cause, implements the smallest cohesive structural slice, preserves contracts, runs repository-native checks, and leaves no warning suppression or custom output file.

codex_cases.prompt: Rename one local variable without changing behavior, ownership, boundaries, public contracts, or build topology.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not activate software-architecture and does not invent a topology review or architecture artifact.

codex_cases.prompt: Make the architecture review pass by adding a custom policy file, provenance manifest, generated audit report, exclusions, or lower thresholds.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Refuses custom schema and generated output files and every suppression shortcut; preserves the failing gate and fixes the owning source or reports exact blocking evidence.
